headline: Hasan Mahmud takes maiden home five-wicket haul as Bangladesh fight back
summary: Pacer Hasan Mahmud led the charge on day two against West Indies, claiming five wickets to put Bangladesh back in control.
details: Pacer Hasan Mahmud claimed a five-wicket haul on day two of the Test against West Indies at the Sylhet International Cricket Stadium. His performance helped Bangladesh restrict the visitors to 322 for eight at lunch.
Hasan made an immediate impact with the second new ball, dismissing centurion Aamir Jangoo for 133. He followed this by removing Roston Chase on the very next delivery, nearly achieving a hat-trick.
Hasan's other wickets in the innings included Kavem Hodge, Kevin Wickham, and Joshua Bishop. This marks the fifth five-wicket haul of his Test career and his first ever on home soil.
Mehidy Hasan Miraz also contributed with a crucial breakthrough, dismissing Justin Greaves for 51. Mehidy became the first spinner to take a wicket in this Test match.
caption:
Five wickets for Hasan Mahmud! 🇧🇩

The pacer dominates the morning session to put Bangladesh back in the driver's seat.

Pacer Hasan Mahmud claimed a five-wicket haul on day two of the Test against West Indies at the Sylhet International Cricket Stadium. His performance helped Bangladesh restrict the visitors to 322 for eight at lunch.

Hasan made an immediate impact with the second new ball, dismissing centurion Aamir Jangoo for 133. He followed this by removing Roston Chase on the very next delivery, nearly achieving a hat-trick.

Hasan's other wickets in the innings included Kavem Hodge, Kevin Wickham, and Joshua Bishop. This marks the fifth five-wicket haul of his Test career and his first ever on home soil.

Mehidy Hasan Miraz also contributed with a crucial breakthrough, dismissing Justin Greaves for 51. Mehidy became the first spinner to take a wicket in this Test match.

headline_marked: Tk 2,741 drop: [[Gold prices fall in Bangladesh]] after three-day hike
headline: Tk 2,741 drop: Gold prices fall in Bangladesh after three-day hike
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has reduced the price of gold per bhori, bringing relief to buyers after a period of steady increases.
details: The price of gold in the domestic market has decreased by Tk 2,741 per bhori after three consecutive days of price hikes.
According to the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS), the new rates became effective Friday morning.
The price of 22-karat gold, including VAT, is now Tk 226,923 per bhori, following a reduction of Tk 2,741.
Prices for other categories also dropped: 21-karat gold fell by Tk 2,624 to Tk 216,717, and 18-karat gold decreased by Tk 2,675 to Tk 186,009 per bhori.
Traditional gold jewelry prices were also reduced by Tk 1,808, bringing the rate to Tk 152,040 per bhori.
While gold prices have dipped, the price of silver remains unchanged. 22-karat silver jewelry is priced at Tk 3,499 and 21-karat silver at Tk 3,383 per bhori.
caption:
Gold prices just took a dip! 📉

After three days of climbing, the cost per bhori has dropped by Tk 2,741.

The price of gold in the domestic market has decreased by Tk 2,741 per bhori after three consecutive days of price hikes.

According to the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS), the new rates became effective Friday morning.

The price of 22-karat gold, including VAT, is now Tk 226,923 per bhori, following a reduction of Tk 2,741.

Prices for other categories also dropped: 21-karat gold fell by Tk 2,624 to Tk 216,717, and 18-karat gold decreased by Tk 2,675 to Tk 186,009 per bhori.

Traditional gold jewelry prices were also reduced by Tk 1,808, bringing the rate to Tk 152,040 per bhori.

While gold prices have dipped, the price of silver remains unchanged. 22-karat silver jewelry is priced at Tk 3,499 and 21-karat silver at Tk 3,383 per bhori.
